meta.scope: Indonesia Batch 4 — Social protection & welfare, Islamic finance, international economic architecture (ASEAN/RCEP), and supporting institutional nodes.

candidates.title: Welfare Indicators (Indikator Kesejahteraan Rakyat)
candidates.description: Annual BPS publication presenting multi-dimensional welfare development over time and across provinces and urban/rural areas. Draws on Susenas, Sakernas, Podes, the Population Census and population projections.
candidates.notes: High-level social-indicator compendium that sits above the individual poverty and Gini series.

candidates.title: BPJS Kesehatan / Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional (JKN) coverage statistics
candidates.description: Administrative and published statistics on membership and coverage of the national health-insurance scheme (JKN) administered by BPJS Kesehatan. Near-universal enrolment numbers are a major social-protection achievement and a continuously cited policy indicator.

candidates.title: Social-protection programme statistics (PKH, food assistance, and related)
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Social Affairs / BPS / related agencies
candidates.description: Statistics and administrative data on major social-assistance programmes, including the conditional cash-transfer programme (PKH) and food-assistance schemes. Central to poverty-reduction strategy and fiscal social spending.
candidates.notes: Programme-level densification of the social-protection cluster.

candidates.title: Islamic / Sharia finance statistics (banking, capital market, non-bank)
candidates.publisher: OJK (Financial Services Authority) / Bank Indonesia / related
candidates.description: Official statistics on the Islamic financial services industry — sharia banking assets and financing, Islamic capital-market instruments, takaful, and related segments. Indonesia ranks among the larger global Islamic-finance markets and publishes dedicated development reports.
candidates.notes: Distinctive financial-system node reflecting Indonesia’s dual conventional/sharia architecture.

candidates.title: OJK – Financial Services Authority institutional and statistical role
candidates.description: Integrated financial-services regulator. Publishes banking, capital-market, non-bank and Islamic-finance statistics and the Indonesian Islamic Finance Development Report, among other products.
candidates.notes: Third institutional pillar of the financial system alongside Bank Indonesia and the Ministry of Finance.

candidates.title: ASEAN economic cooperation framework (Indonesia as member)
candidates.publisher: ASEAN / Indonesian Ministry of Trade and related
candidates.description: Indonesia’s membership and participation in the ASEAN economic community frameworks. Continuously cited in trade, investment and regional-integration policy.
referenced_by: Trade and investment statistics with ASEAN partners

candidates.title: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) — Indonesia participation
candidates.publisher: ASEAN / RCEP parties / Indonesian Ministry of Trade
candidates.description: Indonesia’s participation in RCEP (entered into force for Indonesia January 2023). World’s largest FTA by population and GDP share; continuously cited in trade-policy and supply-chain analysis.

candidates.title: Population projections (Indonesia 2020–2050 and related)
candidates.description: Official population projections based on the 2020 census parameters. Used throughout planning (RPJMN) and as the denominator for many per-capita and coverage indicators.

candidates.title: Village Potential Statistics (Podes)
candidates.description: Periodic census-style data collection on village-level infrastructure, facilities and potential. Unique granular source that feeds many rural-development and welfare analyses.

candidates.title: National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) — statistical targets and monitoring
candidates.description: The successive RPJMN documents set quantitative targets (poverty, inequality, human development, etc.) that are monitored primarily with BPS statistics. Functions as a high-level recurring-citation policy frame that organises much of the official statistical demand.
referenced_by: Poverty, Gini, education, health and welfare statistics
candidates.notes: Central planning-frame node that many social and economic series are designed to serve.

candidates.title: Indonesia social-protection, Islamic-finance and regional-architecture meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from BPS, BPJS, OJK, ASEAN/RCEP and planning sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding welfare indicators, BPJS/JKN coverage, social-assistance programmes, Islamic-finance statistics, OJK, ASEAN, RCEP, population projections, Podes and the RPJMN target frame into a coherent social-protection and external-architecture layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Earlier poverty, labour, financial and trade series
candidates.notes: Integrating node for this batch’s domains.
